run_stat_sig_detector_univariate: run a statistical significance detector on univariate time series data using a rolling t-test between control and test periods
run_stat_sig_detector_multivariate: run a multivariate statistical significance detector with FDR controlling procedure on multiple time series
run_stat_sig_detector_scores_only: run a statistical significance detector in anomaly scores only mode for faster computation without advanced classes
run_stat_sig_detector_with_seasonality: run a statistical significance detector with seasonality removal using weekly daily biweekly monthly or yearly periods
run_stat_sig_detector_bigdata: run a statistical significance detector on long time series that auto-transforms to multivariate for faster processing
